names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 13 ianuarie, «Sfântul Cuvios Maxim Kavsokalivitul».
His baptismal name, as doxologia.ro's life gives it: «pe care din Sfântul Botez l-au numit Manuil».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 13 Ιανουαρίου, «Όσιος Μάξιμος ο Καυσοκαλυβίτης», with the rank word left off.
Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 13 января ст. ст., «Максим Кавсокаливит, прп.», with the rank word left off; the line itself writes «Максима Кавсокалива».

floruit.note: doxologia.ro's life opens «Cuviosul părinte Maxim, care a trăit la anul 1320»; it gives no year of birth or death.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 13 января ст. ст. — «Прп. Максима Кавсокалива (ок. 1365)»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Ιανουαρίου — «Όσιος Μάξιμος ο Καυσοκαλυβίτης»

attestations.note: Not checked: pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

hymns.text:
Darul rugăciunii minţii primind de la Dătătoarea milostivirii,
Ai purtat în cămara inimii pe Focul Cel nestins al iubirii,
Sfinţit de roua Duhului, ai alergat pe pajiştea rugăciunii,
Şi îmbrăcându-te cu smerenia, ai aflat plata nepătimirii,
Părinte Cuvioase Maxim, ca unul ce stai înaintea Treimii,
Roagă-te să ne luminăm noi cu darul înţelepciunii.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Maxim Kavsokalivitul; the page prints no glas

english.text: Receiving the gift of the prayer of the mind from her who gives mercy, thou didst carry in the chamber of the heart the unquenched Fire of love; hallowed by the dew of the Spirit thou didst run in the meadow of prayer, and clothing thyself in humility thou didst find the wage of dispassion. Venerable Father Maximus, as one who stands before the Trinity, pray that we too may be enlightened with the gift of wisdom.

hymns.text:
În curgerile lacrimilor tale ai înecat pe vrăjmaşul mântuirii,
Şi ai alergat cu dor spre lăcaşurile sfinţite ale Treimii,
Văzând cuvioase, în oglinda Duhului tainele dumnezeieşti,
Te-ai făcut luminător lumii şi stâlp al credinţei creştineşti.

source.text: Doxologia — Condacul Sfântului Maxim Kavsokalivitul; the page prints no glas

english.text: In the streams of thy tears thou didst drown the enemy of salvation, and thou didst run with longing towards the hallowed dwellings of the Trinity; seeing, venerable one, the divine mysteries in the mirror of the Spirit, thou wast made a light to the world and a pillar of the Christian faith.

hymns.text: Μητρικῆς ἐκ νηδύος Ὅσιε Μάξιμε, ἐκλογῆς ὡς δοχεῖον ἀνατεθεῖς τῷ Θεῷ, τοῦ θείου γνόφου ὡς Μωσῆς κατηξίωσαι, καὶ τὰ πόρρω προορᾶν, κατὰ τὸν μέγον Σαμουήλ, τοῦ Ἄθω τὸ θεῖον θαῦμα, τῆς Θεοτόκου ὁ μύστης ἡ καὶ πρεσβεύεις Πάτερ ὑπὲρ ἠμῶν.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr) — Όσιος Μάξιμος ο Καυσοκαλυβίτης, Λειτουργικά κείμενα: Ἀπολυτίκιον

english.text: From thy mother's womb, O venerable Maximus, thou wast dedicated to God as a vessel of his choosing; and thou wast counted worthy of the divine darkness as Moses was, and to foresee things far off as the great Samuel did. O divine wonder of Athos, initiate of the Mother of God, who also dost intercede for us, O father.
